column1: # Hand-curated for Brazilian Portuguese: chat abbreviations, interjections and
# loanwords as people type them — so autocorrect leaves them alone and suggests
# them (words the dictionary already has — tá, pra, né, mano — are not repeated
# here). `word<TAB>count[<TAB>model]`: with a model (a verb of the VERO
# dictionary conjugated the same way) tools/lang/pt.sh adds every form
